subject: Target anchoring & safety-net: ops sync
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: growthops@brightpathhealth.com, benjamin.perez@vendorcloud.com
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Target anchoring & safety-net: ops sync

Team — kicking off a short planning thread to anchor targets and define an explicit safety-net for the QBR and annual plan. Goal is to converge on a workable top-line and two downside scenarios by EOD Thu so the finance deck can iterate next week.

High-level asks (bottom-up inputs due Wed COB):
- Product/Eng owners: bottom-up capacity and hiring deltas (FTE + contractors) by quarter; highlight 1–2 roles that are blockers.
- Platform/SRE: expected infra cost bps at baseline and a -15% stress case (include autoscale/burst impacts).
- Sales/Ops: bookings cadence and pipeline conversion assumptions (attach any customer commitments).
- CS/Rev Ops: churn vs. retention sensitivity for target ranges.

Attached is a starter model (2027_target_model_v1.xlsx) and a short note on guardrail rules. I’ve also dropped a Drive folder link with a sample QBR deck template.

Timeline:
- Wed 13 Jan COB: submit bottom-up sheets into Drive
- Thu 14 Jan 11:00 PT: leadership sync (30m) to pick anchoring numbers
- Thu 14 Jan EOD: finalize slides for finance handoff

Please reply with owners and any immediate blockers. I’ll schedule the Thu slot and drop a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Growth & Strategy
Redwood Inference

+1 on the timeline. A couple of strategic notes:
- We should treat the -15% stress case as the operating budget used to size the safety-net (not the primary ask). If we bake that in too early, teams over-constrain hiring.
- Prioritize clarity on near-term deliverables that materially move revenue (market-facing integrations, pricing tests).

I’ll own the calendar and will be on the Thu 11:00 PT slot.

—Vivek

Adding a few practical constraints from the finance side:
- Please make the bottom-up sheet include a column for "high-confidence" hires (offers accepted / budgeted headcount) vs "aspirational" hires. We need that split for cash modeling.
- For infra costs, include both sustained monthly delta and one-time migration/quantization efforts (these drove FY26 variance).

I attached a short note that has a sample QBR slide layout and the sections finance needs for review (QBR_sample_deck_notes.pdf).

Also: looping in BrightPath (growthops@brightpathhealth.com) because they asked to see how we’re thinking about safety-net sizing for partnership commitments. Not expecting them to chime in on internal hires but they may flag contract timing.

Laura Bennett

- Owner: Soojin Lee (Platform), deputy: Marcus Lin (will add Marcus to the sheet).
- Deliverable: cost delta table (sustained monthly, burst cost estimate, and one-time infra program costs) — deliver by Wed 13 Jan 5pm PT.
- Risk callouts: quantization program expected to reduce token cost by ~9% in Q3 but requires 6–8 weeks of infra engineering. If we want the Q3 benefit baked into FY numbers, we need to commit headcount now.

Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Target anchoring & safety-net: ops sync

Thanks all — quick synthesis after the inputs we received: 
- Baseline anchor: $34.2M ARR equivalent (consensus bottom-up).
- Conservative safety-net: -12% (-$4.1M) using LAHIR (low-accept hires + slower conversion) assumptions.
- Upside: +8% if we accelerate two GTM integrations and close three deal pilots in Q2.

Immediate actions:
1) Finance (Laura): take baseline + safety-net and produce two slides for the finance packet by Fri COB (include the high-confidence vs aspirational headcount split).
2) Platform (Soojin): upload the cost delta table and note the scenarios where quantization effort is or isn’t included.
3) GTM (Marissa): submit pipeline conversion sensitivity and highlight the three pilot deals that could produce the upside.
4) Ops note: I’ll prepare a short one-pager that lists guardrail triggers (hiring freeze threshold, runway, minimum gross margin) and attach to the QBR packet.

Calendar: Thu 14 Jan 11:00 PT leadership slot completed as planned; recording and notes are in the Drive link.

If no objections, I’ll hand the slides to finance tonight and we’ll reconvene if anything material changes.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Growth & Strategy
Redwood Inference
